name: leeks vinaigrette
instructions:
The classic french leek side: braised leek halves under a dijon vinaigrette.

=== PROCEDURE ===

1. Cut the leeks IN HALF LENGTHWISE.
2. BRAISE in water + salt + olive oil until tender.
3. SAUTÉ AT THE END: when the water evaporates, let them sauté in the remaining oil — this makes them less soggy (as with all vegetable braises).
4. COVER WITH A [[dijon-vinaigrette]].

Also good WITHOUT the vinaigrette.
notes:
=== THE BRAISE-THEN-SAUTÉ MOVE ===

Sautéing at the end when the water evaporates helps make them LESS SOGGY — the general rule for all vegetable braises: the braise cooks, the evaporate-and-sauté finish concentrates and firms.

=== VINAIGRETTE OPTIONAL ===

The dijon vinaigrette is the classical dressing ([[dijon-vinaigrette]] is the house recipe), but the braised leeks are good on their own too.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[dijon-vinaigrette]]: the dressing.
- [[marcella-lemon-celery]] / [[braised-turnips]] / [[glazed-carrots]]: the other braised vegetable sides.
- [[breadcrumb-leeks]]: the other leek side.
